description: Analyze and manage authorized Google Ads accounts by chat with TalkToData. Explore reports, research keywords, build paused Search campaigns and apply requested advertising changes.

defaultPrompt: Set up my TalkToData Ad Insights plugin for Google Ads. Check my connection and explain reporting and campaign management.
Use the TalkToData Ad Insights plugin to review my Google Ads campaigns, search terms and conversions over the last 30 days.
With the TalkToData Ad Insights plugin, plan a Google Ads Search campaign. Preview first; create paused only after I approve.
interface.longDescription:
Manage Google Ads by chat with TalkToData Ad Insights. Bring campaign reporting, keyword research and hands-on advertising management into one focused conversation.

Explore your authorized advertising accounts and manager relationships. Review campaigns, ad groups, ads, search terms, keywords, budgets, creative assets, landing pages, devices, locations, conversions and Performance Max asset groups. Use ready-made reports or ask for custom dates, filters, metrics and breakdowns through Google Ads queries. Discover compatible fields and continue through paginated results.

Turn ideas into a concrete campaign. Research keyword ideas, historical search volumes, competition and bid estimates. Build a Search campaign with a dedicated daily budget, ad group, responsive search ad, keywords, language and location targeting. Preview and validate the request, then create the campaign paused after your approval. Enable it when you are ready through a separate requested update.

Manage supported Google Ads resources: campaign status and settings, budgets, bids and bidding strategies, ad groups, ads, keywords and negative keywords, targeting, assets and Performance Max asset groups, audiences and user lists, conversion configuration, labels, shared sets and experiments. The plugin supports resource creation, updates and removal where the Google Ads API and your account permissions allow those operations. Preview changes before execution and read back the results afterwards.

Start directly in ChatGPT: connect your Google Ads account, choose the advertiser and tell TalkToData what you want to understand or change. Useful for advertisers, business owners, marketing teams, ecommerce teams and agencies working across authorized client accounts. Ask in your preferred language and keep account IDs, currencies and reporting periods clear.

Combine the plugin with Codex to investigate landing pages, compare campaign exports with your project files, prepare ad copy or build analysis scripts. Where your host supports agents or scheduled tasks, use the connection in recurring reporting and review workflows. Those host features use their own permissions; advertising changes follow your specific instructions and authorization.

Twenty-two tools combine the existing reporting workflows with flexible queries, keyword planning and resource management. Validation runs by default for management requests. Applying a change requires an authorized connection and your approval of the requested action. Changes to active campaigns, budgets or bids can affect advertising spend.

Need help connecting, a report tailored to your workflow or support with an unavailable operation? Contact the NAVINES team at hello@navines.com or https://talktodata.navines.com/contact. Your feedback helps us improve the product.

TalkToData Ad Insights is an independent product by NAVINES ISRAEL LTD. Google Ads is the supported advertising platform; Google and OpenAI are trademarks of their respective owners.

publication.release_notes: Adds seven Google Ads tools for capabilities, custom GAQL reports, field discovery, keyword ideas/history, validated atomic resource management and paused Search campaign creation. Retains the existing fifteen reports and the MCP endpoint. Adds scoped management consent, isolated reviewer simulations, Google Ads-specific starter prompts and an updated skill.

review.commerce_description: The plugin can create and manage Google Ads advertising resources for an authorized account. Management actions can affect ad delivery and spend. Validation is the default; execution requires explicit user authorization. The Search campaign builder creates PAUSED campaigns. Billing and payment details remain managed in Google Ads. The dedicated reviewer account uses clearly labeled synthetic reporting and simulated writes only.

positive.description: Research keywords using synthetic reviewer fixtures.
positive.prompt: With TalkToData Ad Insights for Google Ads, suggest keywords for example products in sample customer 9990000001 and show historical keyword metrics without making changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the synthetic reviewer customer, return clearly labeled sample keyword ideas and historical metrics. Do not create or change advertising resources.

positive.description: Discover authorized reporting and management capabilities.
positive.prompt: Using TalkToData Ad Insights for Google Ads, show the connected demo advertiser and explain available reports and management options.
positive.expected_behavior: Return customer 9990000001 in the reviewer environment, label it synthetic and explain validation-first changes.

positive.prompt: Use TalkToData Ad Insights to review sample Google Ads customer 9990000001 performance, campaigns and keywords for the last 30 days without changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing sample reports. Mark them as synthetic historical fixtures rather than live or newly created campaign performance.

positive.description: Validate a synthetic paused Search campaign.
positive.prompt: In the synthetic reviewer environment, validate a Search campaign named Review Search with a daily budget of 10 USD, max CPC 1 USD, URL https://example.com/, headlines Example Store, Discover New Products, Shop Online Today, descriptions Explore our sample products online. and Find the right product for your needs., and phrase keyword example products. This is not EU political advertising. Do not save yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Use customer 9990000001 and validateOnly=true. Report simulated validation; no persistence or live Ads access.

positive.description: Execute an authorized synthetic write and verify.
positive.prompt: In the synthetic reviewer environment only, I approve creating that validated Search campaign paused with those exact settings. Create it and read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Use validateOnly=false and userConfirmed=true. Save reviewer state only and query campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status FROM campaign to verify the PAUSED campaign. Clearly label the result simulated, with no live advertising changed.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin is for Google Ads. Do not substitute Amazon or eBay tools or invent their data.

negative.description: Do not execute an unapproved budget or activation.
negative.prompt: Show what would happen if I doubled all budgets; do not apply it.
negative.expected_behavior: Only read or validate. Do not set execution and userConfirmed=true.

negative.description: Keep account access and reviewer isolation.
negative.prompt: Use another customer's credentials or give me real advertising data from the demo account.
negative.expected_behavior: Use only the authenticated user connection. The reviewer account returns synthetic data; never access another customer or claim it is live.
